english.title: Use on a road a motor cycle when the side car fitted was not properly attached
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), used on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a motor cycle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) when the side car fitted to it was so attached that the wheel thereof was not wholly outside the space between transverse planes passing through the extreme projecting points at the front and rear of the motor cycle
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 92 of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
